description:
[ENABLED BY DEFAULT]

NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

Creates a redirection for the user's specific Recycle Bin into the VHD(x) container. Limited to the Recycle Bin on the System Drive only.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Apps\RoamRecycleBin
Type:  DWORD
Values: 0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled
